an5.77:1.1: ‘‘Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, anāgatabhayāni sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati –
an5.77:2.4: Ekakaṃ kho pana maṃ araññe viharantaṃ
an5.77:2.5: ahi vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya, vicchiko vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya, satapadī vā maṃ ḍaṃseyya,
an5.77:2.6: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
an5.77:2.7: handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
an5.77:2.8: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:3.1: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati –
an5.77:3.4: upakkhalitvā vā papateyyaṃ, bhattaṃ vā bhuttaṃ me byāpajjeyya, pittaṃ vā me kuppeyya, semhaṃ vā me kuppeyya, satthakā vā me vātā kuppeyyuṃ,
an5.77:3.5: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
an5.77:3.6: handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
an5.77:3.7: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:4.1: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati –
an5.77:4.4: vāḷehi samāgaccheyyaṃ, sīhena vā byagghena vā dīpinā vā acchena vā taracchena vā, te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyuṃ,
an5.77:4.5: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
an5.77:4.6: handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
an5.77:4.7: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:5.1: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati –
an5.77:5.4: māṇavehi samāgaccheyyaṃ katakammehi vā akatakammehi vā, te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyuṃ,
an5.77:5.5: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
an5.77:5.6: handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
an5.77:5.7: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, catutthaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:6.1: ‘‘Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, āraññiko bhikkhu iti paṭisañcikkhati –
an5.77:6.3: Santi kho panāraññe vāḷā amanussā, te maṃ jīvitā voropeyyuṃ,
an5.77:6.4: tena me assa kālaṅkiriyā, so mamassa antarāyo;
an5.77:6.5: handāhaṃ vīriyaṃ ārabhāmi appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’ti.
an5.77:6.6: Idaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcamaṃ anāgatabhayaṃ sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an5.77:7.1: ‘‘Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca anāgatabhayāni sampassamānena alameva āraññikena bhikkhunā appamattena ātāpinā pahitattena viharituṃ appattassa pattiyā anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāyā’’ti.
